heading: Disposition of fees
lead: Except as provided in sections 7470A and 7475, all fees received by the Tax Court pursuant to this title shall be deposited into a special fund of the Treasury to be available to offset funds appropriated for the operation and maintenance of the Tax Court.

notes.text: Amendments2015—Pub. L. 114–113 amended section generally. Prior to amendment, text read as follows: “Except as provided in section 7475, all fees received by the Tax Court shall be covered into the Treasury as miscellaneous receipts.” 1986—Pub. L. 99–514 substituted “Except as provided in section 7475, all” for “All”.
Effective Date of 1986 AmendmentAmendment by Pub. L. 99–514 effective Jan. 1, 1987, see section 1553(c) of Pub. L. 99–514, set out as an Effective Date note under section 7475 of this title.
